g.data-label: The skin: 2024-T3 aluminium sheet, 1.6 mm thick, 1.0668 m along the fuselage by 0.760 m around it.
Four stringer bays across the panel, 190 mm each. The stringers are 7075-T6 Z sections inside the skin, running along the fuselage.
Two frame bays along the panel, 533 mm each. The frames are deeper 7075-T6 Z sections that run around the fuselage.
The edges are clamped, where the next frames and stringers would be.
The bird flies at 180 m/s into the middle of the skin: a 4 lb cylinder, 113 mm across and 226 mm long.
